# Jenny Bu

> Landscape architecture and outdoor living for homes in Toronto and York Region: pools, terraces, outdoor kitchens and lit entries, designed as one. The site and the conversation are in English or Chinese.

The practice works in Toronto, North York, Markham, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Aurora and Thornhill. Every project on the site is a completed build. Advisory before a purchase or a listing is a designer's read of the grounds, not a home inspection, staging, or an appraisal.

- Contact: https://jennybu.ca/contact
- Email: askjennybu@gmail.com
- Phone: +1-647-879-1206

## Services

- [Landscape design](https://jennybu.ca/services/landscape-design): Whole-property design. Drive, entry, side yards, terrace, planting and lighting planned as one sequence.
- [Pools and water](https://jennybu.ca/services/pools-and-water): Pools, spillover spas, rock waterfalls and night lighting, drawn with the terrace around them.
- [Outdoor living](https://jennybu.ca/services/outdoor-living): Outdoor kitchens, timber pergolas, terraces and fire pits, as one room rather than a line of equipment.
- [Property advisory](https://jennybu.ca/services/property-advisory): Before buying or listing, what the lot can become and what the grounds are worth to the next owner.

## Completed work

- [The pool at golden hour](https://jennybu.ca/work/sunset-pool): Spillover spa, west-facing lounge deck.
- [Fire pit and outdoor kitchen](https://jennybu.ca/work/fire-pit-yard): Cooking and gathering on one terrace.
- [A kitchen under timber](https://jennybu.ca/work/pergola-kitchen): Outdoor kitchen and bar under a timber pergola.
- [Water, stone and play after dark](https://jennybu.ca/work/waterfall-pool-night): Round pool, rock waterfall and putting green.
- [From the drive to the pool](https://jennybu.ca/work/estate-aerial): Drive, house, terrace, hot tub and pool as one plan.
- [A lit front entry](https://jennybu.ca/work/front-entry): Stone pillars, layered planting and low lighting.
